examples.label: A block shadows a name
examples.purpose: Two declarations of x are two locations; the inner one hides the outer one until the block ends.

examples.label: Recursion: many locations
examples.purpose: Each activation of f has its own x: one identifier, three locations alive at once.

examples.label: A free name
examples.purpose: f uses a global x. Static scoping finds it; dynamic scoping finds the x of whoever called f.
text: proc g() { var x = 2; call f(); }

examples.label: Definition nesting or call chain
examples.purpose: inner is defined in outer but called from middle: the two rules follow different frames.
text: proc middle() { var n = 30; call inner(); }

examples.label: A parameter captures a name
examples.purpose: Under dynamic scoping the parameter limit of run is seen by show, which only meant the global one.

examples.label: Aliasing a global
examples.purpose: The argument g is also visible by name. Value, reference, value-result and name give four different results.

examples.label: Swap
examples.purpose: Only by value fails to swap: the other modes reach the caller's variables.
text: proc swap(a, b) { var t = a; a = b; b = t; }

examples.label: Aliased arguments
examples.purpose: p(x, x) with an assignment to one parameter: value-result copies the unchanged one back last.

examples.label: swap(i, a[i])
examples.purpose: By name, the argument a[i] is evaluated again after i has changed: the swap breaks.
text: proc swap(p, q) { var t = p; p = q; q = t; }

examples.label: Evaluations and side effects
examples.purpose: tick() has a side effect. By name it is evaluated at each use of x.
text: func tick() { n = n + 1; return n; }

examples.label: An argument never used
examples.purpose: By name the argument loop() is never evaluated, so the call ends; the other modes do not.

examples.label: Jensen's device
examples.purpose: By name, k and term are re-evaluated on each use, so sum works for any term in i.
text: while (k <= hi) { s = s + term; k = k + 1; }

examples.label: Passing an array
examples.purpose: By value the reference is copied: the elements are shared, the rebinding of v is not.

examples.label: A thunk and the callee's local
examples.purpose: By name, the argument t + 1 means 6 under static scoping and 101 under dynamic scoping.
